purpose: Source-faithful reconstructed Unity/glTF Home for WebXR
how_used: Original node hierarchy and geometry are recovered from embedded GLB assets. One uniform 1.4 scale and 180-degree Y rotation place the source entrance at the chase lane. Grounding/boundary corrections are reported in window.__homeGltf. Runtime uses native textured assets and recovered four-color brick materials, with a single shared door. Procedural family animation and notebook remain.
